name: deBridge Finance
rootCause: deBridge Finance disclosed a thwarted early-August 2022 phishing attempt that impersonated co-founder Alex Smirnov and used a salary-adjustment lure. The public record says no damage was done, and the available evidence points to endpoint compromise, not an on-chain exploit. A spoofed email used the lure "New Salary Adjustments" to drive user execution of a disguised attachment on Windows. Public descriptions differ on the first-stage file format, but they converge on the same outcome: a shortcut or launch path that invoked native Windows tooling such as cmd.exe and mshta.exe to stage a backdoor. No protocol or smart contract flaw was involved.
